processes.realtime_position_deal_handoff: Real-time desk lead tells schedulers/coordinators the short or long positions and deals to enter in Enpower, CAPS and position manager, including price checks with other traders.
processes.cut_schedule_handling_instructions: Desk lead instructs the real-time group how to record, zero out, and track cut schedules and counterparty cuts in the scheduling and confirmation systems.
processes.iso_market_notice_relay: Forwarding CAISO or counterparty market notices (derates, SCID changes, market republishing, rulings) to the real-time group so they can adjust.
processes.trade_tape_pull_dispute_support: Requesting or arranging recorded-call tape pulls to resolve disputes over what was traded with a counterparty.
